purpose.statement: COPAUS1C is a CICS COBOL IMS BMS program within the CardDemo Authorization Module that provides a Detail View of a selected Pending Authorization Message. It allows users to view full authorization details, navigate to the next authorization record (PF8), flag or unflag an authorization as fraudulent (PF5), and return to the Authorization Summary screen (PF3).

code_references.snippet:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. COPAUS1C.
       AUTHOR.     AWS.

MAIN-PARA.
           SET ERR-FLG-OFF     TO TRUE
           SET SEND-ERASE-YES  TO TRUE
           ...
           EVALUATE EIBAID
               WHEN DFHENTER
                   PERFORM PROCESS-ENTER-KEY
               WHEN DFHPF3
                   MOVE WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY     TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM
                   PERFORM RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN
               WHEN DFHPF5
                   PERFORM MARK-AUTH-FRAUD
               WHEN DFHPF8
                   PERFORM PROCESS-PF8-KEY
           END-EVALUATE

business_rules.statement: If no communication area is passed (EIBCALEN = 0), the program treats the session as uninitiated, initializes the commarea, sets the target program to the Authorization Summary (COPAUS0C), and transfers control back to the summary screen.

code_references.snippet:
IF EIBCALEN = 0
               INITIALIZE CARDDEMO-COMMAREA
               MOVE WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY        TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM
               PERFORM RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN

business_rules.statement: On first entry (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is FALSE), the program sets the re-entry flag to TRUE, processes the Enter key logic to load the selected authorization, and sends the detail screen.

code_references.snippet:
IF NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER
                   SET CDEMO-PGM-REENTER    TO TRUE
                   PERFORM PROCESS-ENTER-KEY
                   PERFORM SEND-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN

business_rules.statement: PF3 key returns the user to the Authorization Summary screen (COPAUS0C) by transferring control via XCTL.

code_references.snippet:
WHEN DFHPF3
                           MOVE WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY     TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM
                           PERFORM RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN

business_rules.statement: PF5 key triggers the fraud marking/unmarking workflow (MARK-AUTH-FRAUD) and then refreshes the detail screen.

code_references.snippet:
WHEN DFHPF5
                           PERFORM MARK-AUTH-FRAUD
                           PERFORM SEND-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN

business_rules.statement: PF8 key advances to the next authorization detail record for the same account. If no next record exists, the message 'Already at the last Authorization...' is displayed and the screen is not erased.

code_references.snippet:
WHEN DFHPF8
                           PERFORM PROCESS-PF8-KEY
                           PERFORM SEND-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN

PROCESS-PF8-KEY.
           ...
           IF AUTHS-EOF
              SET SEND-ERASE-NO          TO TRUE
              MOVE 'Already at the last Authorization...'
                                         TO WS-MESSAGE
           ELSE
              MOVE PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY  TO CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED
              PERFORM POPULATE-AUTH-DETAILS
           END-IF

business_rules.statement: Any unrecognized AID key triggers PROCESS-ENTER-KEY and then displays the generic invalid-key message (CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY).

code_references.snippet:
WHEN OTHER
                           PERFORM PROCESS-ENTER-KEY
                           MOVE CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY TO WS-MESSAGE
                           PERFORM SEND-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN

business_rules.statement: The selected authorization record can only be read if CDEMO-ACCT-ID is numeric AND CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED is not spaces or low-values. If either condition fails, the error flag is set ON.

code_references.snippet:
PROCESS-ENTER-KEY.
           MOVE LOW-VALUES          TO COPAU1AO
           IF CDEMO-ACCT-ID IS NUMERIC AND
              CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES
              MOVE CDEMO-ACCT-ID            TO WS-ACCT-ID
              MOVE CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED  TO WS-AUTH-KEY
              PERFORM READ-AUTH-RECORD
              ...
           ELSE
              SET ERR-FLG-ON                TO TRUE
           END-IF

business_rules.statement: Authorization response code '00' maps to an Approved status ('A') displayed in green. Any other response code maps to a Declined status ('D') displayed in red.

code_references.snippet:
IF PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE = '00'
                  MOVE 'A'                    TO AUTHRSPO
                  MOVE DFHGREEN               TO AUTHRSPC
               ELSE
                  MOVE 'D'                    TO AUTHRSPO
                  MOVE DFHRED                 TO AUTHRSPC
               END-IF

business_rules.statement: The decline reason code is looked up using a binary search against a 10-entry table. Codes include 0000=APPROVED, 3100=INVALID CARD, 4100=INSUFFICNT FUND, 4200=CARD NOT ACTIVE, 4300=ACCOUNT CLOSED, 4400=EXCED DAILY LMT, 5100=CARD FRAUD, 5200=MERCHANT FRAUD, 5300=LOST CARD, 9000=UNKNOWN. If no match is found, '9999-ERROR' is displayed.

code_references.snippet:
01 WS-TABLES.
          05 WS-DECLINE-REASON-TABLE.
             10   PIC X(20) VALUE '0000APPROVED'.
             10   PIC X(20) VALUE '3100INVALID CARD'.
             10   PIC X(20) VALUE '4100INSUFFICNT FUND'.
             10   PIC X(20) VALUE '4200CARD NOT ACTIVE'.
             10   PIC X(20) VALUE '4300ACCOUNT CLOSED'.
             10   PIC X(20) VALUE '4400EXCED DAILY LMT'.
             10   PIC X(20) VALUE '5100CARD FRAUD'.
             10   PIC X(20) VALUE '5200MERCHANT FRAUD'.
             10   PIC X(20) VALUE '5300LOST CARD'.
             10   PIC X(20) VALUE '9000UNKNOWN'.

SEARCH ALL WS-DECLINE-REASON-TAB
                   AT END
                        MOVE '9999'                     TO AUTHRSNO
                        MOVE '-'                        TO AUTHRSNO(5:1)
                        MOVE 'ERROR'                    TO AUTHRSNO(6:)
                   WHEN DECL-CODE(WS-DECL-RSN-IDX) = PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON
                        MOVE PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON        TO AUTHRSNO
                        MOVE '-'                        TO AUTHRSNO(5:1)
                        MOVE DECL-DESC(WS-DECL-RSN-IDX) TO AUTHRSNO(6:)
               END-SEARCH

business_rules.statement: If an authorization already has PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED status, pressing PF5 toggles it to PA-FRAUD-REMOVED and sets WS-REMOVE-FRAUD. If it is not yet confirmed fraud, it is set to PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED and WS-REPORT-FRAUD is set.

code_references.snippet:
MARK-AUTH-FRAUD.
           ...
           IF PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED
              SET PA-FRAUD-REMOVED          TO TRUE
              SET WS-REMOVE-FRAUD           TO TRUE
           ELSE
              SET PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED        TO TRUE
              SET WS-REPORT-FRAUD           TO TRUE
           END-IF

business_rules.statement: The fraud action is delegated to external program COPAUS2C via CICS LINK. If EIBRESP is NORMAL and the fraud update succeeds (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS), the IMS record is updated. Otherwise, a rollback is performed and the error/action message is shown.

code_references.snippet:
EXEC CICS LINK
                PROGRAM(WS-PGM-AUTH-FRAUD)
                COMMAREA(WS-FRAUD-DATA)
                NOHANDLE
           END-EXEC
           IF EIBRESP = DFHRESP(NORMAL)
              IF WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS
                 PERFORM UPDATE-AUTH-DETAILS
              ELSE
                 MOVE WS-FRD-ACT-MSG     TO WS-MESSAGE
                 PERFORM ROLL-BACK
              END-IF
           ELSE
              PERFORM ROLL-BACK
           END-IF

business_rules.statement: If an authorization is confirmed fraud or has been removed from fraud, the fraud field on screen shows the fraud code, a hyphen separator, and the fraud report date. Otherwise, only a hyphen is displayed.

code_references.snippet:
IF PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED OR PA-FRAUD-REMOVED
                  MOVE PA-AUTH-FRAUD          TO AUTHFRDO(1:1)
                  MOVE '-'                    TO AUTHFRDO(2:1)
                  MOVE PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE      TO AUTHFRDO(3:)
               ELSE
                  MOVE '-'                    TO AUTHFRDO
               END-IF

business_rules.statement: The IMS PSB is scheduled before each IMS DLI read operation. If the PSB was already scheduled (TC status code), it is terminated and rescheduled. If scheduling fails for any other reason, the error flag is set and an error message is displayed.

code_references.snippet:
SCHEDULE-PSB.
           EXEC DLI SCHD
                PSB((PSB-NAME))
                NODHABEND
           END-EXEC
           MOVE DIBSTAT        TO IMS-RETURN-CODE
           IF PSB-SCHEDULED-MORE-THAN-ONCE
              EXEC DLI TERM
              END-EXEC
              EXEC DLI SCHD
                   PSB((PSB-NAME))
                   NODHABEND
              END-EXEC
              MOVE DIBSTAT     TO IMS-RETURN-CODE
           END-IF
           IF STATUS-OK
              SET IMS-PSB-SCHD           TO TRUE
           ELSE
              MOVE 'Y'     TO WS-ERR-FLG
              ...

business_rules.statement: After a successful read or fraud update, a CICS SYNCPOINT is issued to commit IMS database changes. After a failed fraud update or CICS LINK failure, a CICS SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK is issued to undo IMS changes.

code_references.snippet:
TAKE-SYNCPOINT.
           EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT
           END-EXEC

ROLL-BACK.
           EXEC CICS
              SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK
           END-EXEC

business_rules.statement: The card expiry date is formatted with a slash separator for display (e.g., MM/YY) by moving the first two characters, then a literal '/', then the last two characters.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE PA-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE(1:2)  TO CRDEXPO(1:2)
               MOVE '/'                       TO CRDEXPO(3:1)
               MOVE PA-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE(3:2)  TO CRDEXPO(4:2)

business_rules.statement: The authorization date is reformatted from YYMMDD (IMS storage) to MM/DD/YY for screen display by mapping PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE subfields to WS-CURDATE components.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE(1:2)    TO WS-CURDATE-YY
               MOVE PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE(3:2)    TO WS-CURDATE-MM
               MOVE PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE(5:2)    TO WS-CURDATE-DD
               MOVE WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY       TO WS-AUTH-DATE
               MOVE WS-AUTH-DATE              TO AUTHDTO

business_rules.statement: The authorization time is reformatted from HHMMSS (IMS storage) to HH:MM:SS for screen display using positional moves.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME(1:2)    TO WS-AUTH-TIME(1:2)
               MOVE PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME(3:2)    TO WS-AUTH-TIME(4:2)
               MOVE PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME(5:2)    TO WS-AUTH-TIME(7:2)
               MOVE WS-AUTH-TIME              TO AUTHTMO

inputs.statement: IMS PSB PSBPAUTB is used to access the Pending Authorization IMS database. It contains at minimum one PCB (PAUT-PCB-NUM = 1) providing access to the authorization summary and detail segments.

code_references.snippet:
01 WS-IMS-VARIABLES.
          05 PSB-NAME                        PIC X(8) VALUE 'PSBPAUTB'.
          05 PCB-OFFSET.
             10 PAUT-PCB-NUM                 PIC S9(4) COMP VALUE +1.

inputs.statement: IMS segment PAUTSUM0 (Pending Authorization Summary - Root segment) is read using a GU DLI call keyed by account ID (ACCNTID = PA-ACCT-ID).

code_references.snippet:
EXEC DLI GU USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
               SEGMENT (PAUTSUM0)
               INTO (PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY)
               WHERE (ACCNTID = PA-ACCT-ID)
           END-EXEC

01 PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY.
       COPY CIPAUSMY.

inputs.statement: IMS segment PAUTDTL1 (Pending Authorization Details - Child segment) is read using GNP DLI calls keyed by authorization key (PAUT9CTS = PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY), under the parent summary segment.

code_references.snippet:
EXEC DLI GNP USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
                  SEGMENT (PAUTDTL1)
                  INTO (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS)
                  WHERE (PAUT9CTS = PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY)
              END-EXEC

01 PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS.
       COPY CIPAUDTY.

inputs.statement: CICS COMMAREA (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, sourced from COCOM01Y copybook) is used as input to carry session state including account ID, customer ID, selected authorization key, transaction context, and fraud data between screen interactions.

code_references.snippet:
LINKAGE SECTION.
       01  DFHCOMMAREA.
         05  LK-COMMAREA                           PIC X(01)
             OCCURS 1 TO 32767 TIMES DEPENDING ON EIBCALEN.
MOVE DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN) TO CARDDEMO-COMMAREA

inputs.statement: BMS map COPAU1A within mapset COPAU01 is used for screen input (RECEIVE) to capture any operator-entered data on the authorization detail screen.

code_references.snippet:
RECEIVE-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN.
           EXEC CICS RECEIVE
                     MAP('COPAU1A')
                     MAPSET('COPAU01')
                     INTO(COPAU1AI)
                     NOHANDLE
           END-EXEC

outputs.statement: BMS map COPAU1A within mapset COPAU01 is used for screen output (SEND) to display authorization detail fields, header information, status indicators, and error messages to the user.

code_references.snippet:
SEND-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN.
           PERFORM POPULATE-HEADER-INFO
           MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO OF COPAU1AO
           ...
           EXEC CICS SEND
                  MAP('COPAU1A')
                  MAPSET('COPAU01')
                  FROM(COPAU1AO)
                  ERASE
                  CURSOR
           END-EXEC

outputs.statement: The updated IMS PAUTDTL1 segment (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS) is written back to the IMS database via a DLI REPL call during fraud status updates.

code_references.snippet:
UPDATE-AUTH-DETAILS.
           MOVE WS-FRAUD-AUTH-RECORD           TO PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS
           ...
           EXEC DLI REPL USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
                SEGMENT (PAUTDTL1)
                FROM (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS)
           END-EXEC

outputs.statement: The updated CARDDEMO-COMMAREA is passed back to the CICS transaction CPVD on each RETURN, preserving state including the currently selected authorization key and fraud data.

code_references.snippet:
EXEC CICS RETURN
                     TRANSID (WS-CICS-TRANID)
                     COMMAREA (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)
           END-EXEC

outputs.statement: WS-FRAUD-DATA commarea is passed to program COPAUS2C (fraud handler) via CICS LINK, conveying the account ID, customer ID, authorization record, and fraud action flag.

code_references.snippet:
EXEC CICS LINK
                PROGRAM(WS-PGM-AUTH-FRAUD)
                COMMAREA(WS-FRAUD-DATA)
                NOHANDLE
           END-EXEC

processing_logic.statement: Initialization: Error and erase flags are reset to their default values (ERR-FLG-OFF, SEND-ERASE-YES), and the message and error output fields are cleared to spaces.

code_references.snippet:
MAIN-PARA.
           SET ERR-FLG-OFF     TO TRUE
           SET SEND-ERASE-YES  TO TRUE
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-MESSAGE
                          ERRMSGO OF COPAU1AO

processing_logic.statement: Commarea check: If EIBCALEN = 0, the commarea is initialized and control is immediately transferred back to COPAUS0C (summary screen). Otherwise, the passed commarea is loaded into CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and CDEMO-CPVD-FRAUD-DATA is cleared.

code_references.snippet:
IF EIBCALEN = 0
               INITIALIZE CARDDEMO-COMMAREA
               MOVE WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY        TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM
               PERFORM RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN
           ELSE
               MOVE DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN) TO CARDDEMO-COMMAREA
               MOVE SPACES                  TO CDEMO-CPVD-FRAUD-DATA

processing_logic.statement: First-entry processing (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is FALSE): The re-entry flag is set, the selected authorization record is read from IMS, the detail screen fields are populated, and the screen is sent.

code_references.snippet:
IF NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER
                   SET CDEMO-PGM-REENTER    TO TRUE
                   PERFORM PROCESS-ENTER-KEY
                   PERFORM SEND-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN

processing_logic.statement: Re-entry processing: The BMS screen is received to capture AID key, then branched based on EIBAID: Enter reloads and redisplays, PF3 exits to summary, PF5 toggles fraud, PF8 advances to next record, any other key shows an invalid-key message.

code_references.snippet:
ELSE
                   PERFORM RECEIVE-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN
                   EVALUATE EIBAID
                       WHEN DFHENTER ...
                       WHEN DFHPF3 ...
                       WHEN DFHPF5 ...
                       WHEN DFHPF8 ...
                       WHEN OTHER ...
                   END-EVALUATE
               END-IF

processing_logic.statement: READ-AUTH-RECORD: The IMS PSB is scheduled, then a GU call retrieves the pending authorization summary root segment by account ID. If found, a GNP call retrieves the specific detail child segment by authorization key. IMS status codes are evaluated after each call and EOF/error flags are set accordingly.

code_references.snippet:
READ-AUTH-RECORD.
           PERFORM SCHEDULE-PSB
           MOVE WS-ACCT-ID                TO PA-ACCT-ID
           MOVE WS-AUTH-KEY               TO PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY
           EXEC DLI GU USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
               SEGMENT (PAUTSUM0)
               INTO (PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY)
               WHERE (ACCNTID = PA-ACCT-ID)
           END-EXEC
           ...
           IF AUTHS-NOT-EOF
              EXEC DLI GNP USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
                  SEGMENT (PAUTDTL1)
                  INTO (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS)
                  WHERE (PAUT9CTS = PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY)
              END-EXEC
           END-IF

processing_logic.statement: READ-NEXT-AUTH-RECORD: Issues a GNP call (without a WHERE qualifier) to fetch the next sibling PAUTDTL1 detail segment under the current parent. Sets AUTHS-EOF if no more records exist.

code_references.snippet:
READ-NEXT-AUTH-RECORD.
           EXEC DLI GNP USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
               SEGMENT (PAUTDTL1)
               INTO (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS)
           END-EXEC
           MOVE DIBSTAT                          TO IMS-RETURN-CODE
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN STATUS-OK
                  SET AUTHS-NOT-EOF              TO TRUE
               WHEN SEGMENT-NOT-FOUND
               WHEN END-OF-DB
                  SET AUTHS-EOF                  TO TRUE
               ...

processing_logic.statement: POPULATE-AUTH-DETAILS: When no error flag is set, all authorization detail fields (card number, date, time, amount, response code/reason, processing code, POS entry mode, message source, MCC, card expiry, auth type, transaction ID, match status, fraud status, merchant details) are moved from the IMS detail record into the BMS output map fields.

code_references.snippet:
POPULATE-AUTH-DETAILS.
           IF ERR-FLG-OFF
               MOVE PA-CARD-NUM               TO CARDNUMO
               ...
               MOVE PA-MERCHANT-NAME          TO MERNAMEO
               MOVE PA-MERCHANT-ID            TO MERIDO
               MOVE PA-MERCHANT-CITY          TO MERCITYO
               MOVE PA-MERCHANT-STATE         TO MERSTO
               MOVE PA-MERCHANT-ZIP           TO MERZIPO
           END-IF

processing_logic.statement: POPULATE-HEADER-INFO: The current date and time are obtained using FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE and formatted into MM/DD/YY and HH:MM:SS formats. Screen title lines, transaction name, program name, date, and time are then moved to the BMS map header output fields.

code_references.snippet:
POPULATE-HEADER-INFO.
           MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE  TO WS-CURDATE-DATA
           MOVE CCDA-TITLE01           TO TITLE01O OF COPAU1AO
           MOVE CCDA-TITLE02           TO TITLE02O OF COPAU1AO
           MOVE WS-CICS-TRANID         TO TRNNAMEO OF COPAU1AO
           MOVE WS-PGM-AUTH-DTL        TO PGMNAMEO OF COPAU1AO
           ...
           MOVE WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY    TO CURDATEO OF COPAU1AO
           ...
           MOVE WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS    TO CURTIMEO OF COPAU1AO

processing_logic.statement: MARK-AUTH-FRAUD processing: Reads the current IMS record, toggles fraud flag on the in-memory segment, links to COPAUS2C for external fraud processing, then either updates the IMS record and commits (on success) or rolls back (on failure).

code_references.snippet:
MARK-AUTH-FRAUD.
           MOVE CDEMO-ACCT-ID            TO WS-ACCT-ID
           MOVE CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED  TO WS-AUTH-KEY
           PERFORM READ-AUTH-RECORD
           IF PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED
              SET PA-FRAUD-REMOVED          TO TRUE
              SET WS-REMOVE-FRAUD           TO TRUE
           ELSE
              SET PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED        TO TRUE
              SET WS-REPORT-FRAUD           TO TRUE
           END-IF
           ...
           EXEC CICS LINK PROGRAM(WS-PGM-AUTH-FRAUD) ...
           IF EIBRESP = DFHRESP(NORMAL)
              IF WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS
                 PERFORM UPDATE-AUTH-DETAILS
              ELSE
                 PERFORM ROLL-BACK
              END-IF
           ELSE
              PERFORM ROLL-BACK
           END-IF

processing_logic.statement: Termination: Control is returned to CICS with transaction ID CPVD and the current CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, causing the terminal to be ready for the next interaction.

code_references.snippet:
EXEC CICS RETURN
                     TRANSID (WS-CICS-TRANID)
                     COMMAREA (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)
           END-EXEC

dependencies.statement: COPAUS0C (Authorization Summary screen program) - target for PF3 navigation and default return when no commarea is present.

code_references.snippet: 05 WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY           PIC X(08) VALUE 'COPAUS0C'.
MOVE WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY        TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM

dependencies.statement: COPAUS2C (Authorization Fraud Handler program) - called via CICS LINK to process fraud reporting or removal actions for a pending authorization record.

code_references.snippet: 05 WS-PGM-AUTH-FRAUD          PIC X(08) VALUE 'COPAUS2C'.

EXEC CICS LINK
                PROGRAM(WS-PGM-AUTH-FRAUD)
                COMMAREA(WS-FRAUD-DATA)
                NOHANDLE
           END-EXEC

dependencies.statement: IMS PSB PSBPAUTB - the Program Specification Block used to access the Pending Authorization IMS database segments PAUTSUM0 and PAUTDTL1.

code_references.snippet: 05 PSB-NAME                        PIC X(8) VALUE 'PSBPAUTB'.

SCHEDULE-PSB.
           EXEC DLI SCHD
                PSB((PSB-NAME))
                NODHABEND
           END-EXEC

dependencies.statement: CICS Transaction CPVD - the transaction identifier used on RETURN and XCTL to maintain the pseudo-conversational loop for the Authorization Detail view.

code_references.snippet: 05 WS-CICS-TRANID             PIC X(04) VALUE 'CPVD'.

EXEC CICS RETURN
                     TRANSID (WS-CICS-TRANID)
                     COMMAREA (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)
           END-EXEC

dependencies.statement: Copybook COCOM01Y - defines the CARDDEMO-COMMAREA common communication area structure including program context, account/customer IDs, and CPVD-specific navigation fields.

code_references.snippet: COPY COCOM01Y.

dependencies.statement: Copybook COPAU01 - defines the BMS map structures COPAU1AI (input) and COPAU1AO (output) for the authorization detail screen COPAU1A in mapset COPAU01.

code_references.snippet: COPY COPAU01.

dependencies.statement: Copybook CIPAUSMY - defines the layout of the PAUTSUM0 IMS Pending Authorization Summary root segment.

code_references.snippet:
01 PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY.
       COPY CIPAUSMY.

dependencies.statement: Copybook CIPAUDTY - defines the layout of the PAUTDTL1 IMS Pending Authorization Details child segment.

code_references.snippet:
01 PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS.
       COPY CIPAUDTY.

dependencies.statement: Copybook COTTL01Y - provides the application screen title constants (CCDA-TITLE01, CCDA-TITLE02) displayed in the screen header.

code_references.snippet: COPY COTTL01Y.

dependencies.statement: Copybook CSDAT01Y - provides working-storage date/time formatting fields (WS-CURDATE-DATA, WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY, WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS, etc.) used in POPULATE-HEADER-INFO.

code_references.snippet: COPY CSDAT01Y.

dependencies.statement: Copybook CSMSG01Y - provides common message constants including CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY used when an unrecognized AID key is pressed.

code_references.snippet: COPY CSMSG01Y.

dependencies.statement: Copybook CSMSG02Y - provides abend-related working-storage variables for abend handling support.

code_references.snippet: COPY CSMSG02Y.

dependencies.statement: Copybook DFHAID - provides CICS attention identifier (AID) constants (DFHENTER, DFHPF3, DFHPF5, DFHPF8) used in the EVALUATE EIBAID block.

code_references.snippet: COPY DFHAID.

dependencies.statement: Copybook DFHBMSCA - provides BMS color attribute constants (DFHGREEN, DFHRED) used for the authorization response code color coding on screen.

code_references.snippet: COPY DFHBMSCA.

error_handling.statement: IMS GU call failure during READ-AUTH-RECORD: If the DLI status code is not STATUS-OK, SEGMENT-NOT-FOUND, or END-OF-DB, the error flag is set to 'Y', an error message including the IMS return code is built via STRING, and the screen is sent immediately.

code_references.snippet:
EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN STATUS-OK
                  SET AUTHS-NOT-EOF              TO TRUE
               WHEN SEGMENT-NOT-FOUND
               WHEN END-OF-DB
                  SET AUTHS-EOF                  TO TRUE
               WHEN OTHER
                  MOVE 'Y'     TO WS-ERR-FLG
                  STRING
                  ' System error while reading Auth Summary: Code:'
                  IMS-RETURN-CODE
                  DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  INTO WS-MESSAGE
                  END-STRING
                  PERFORM SEND-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN
           END-EVALUATE

error_handling.statement: IMS GNP call failure during READ-AUTH-RECORD (detail segment): Same pattern - error flag set, STRING-built message including IMS return code, immediate screen send.

code_references.snippet:
EVALUATE TRUE
                  WHEN STATUS-OK
                     SET AUTHS-NOT-EOF              TO TRUE
                  WHEN SEGMENT-NOT-FOUND
                  WHEN END-OF-DB
                     SET AUTHS-EOF                  TO TRUE
                  WHEN OTHER
                     MOVE 'Y'     TO WS-ERR-FLG
                     STRING
                     ' System error while reading Auth Details: Code:'
                     IMS-RETURN-CODE
                     DELIMITED BY SIZE
                     INTO WS-MESSAGE
                     END-STRING
                     PERFORM SEND-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN
              END-EVALUATE

error_handling.statement: IMS GNP call failure during READ-NEXT-AUTH-RECORD: Error flag set, STRING-built message with IMS code, screen sent immediately.

code_references.snippet:
EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN STATUS-OK
                  SET AUTHS-NOT-EOF              TO TRUE
               WHEN SEGMENT-NOT-FOUND
               WHEN END-OF-DB
                  SET AUTHS-EOF                  TO TRUE
               WHEN OTHER
                  MOVE 'Y'     TO WS-ERR-FLG
                  STRING
                  ' System error while reading next Auth: Code:'
                  IMS-RETURN-CODE
                  DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  INTO WS-MESSAGE
                  END-STRING
                  PERFORM SEND-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN
           END-EVALUATE

error_handling.statement: IMS REPL call failure during UPDATE-AUTH-DETAILS: A rollback is performed, the error flag is set, an error message including the IMS return code is built, and the screen is sent immediately.

code_references.snippet:
EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN STATUS-OK
                  PERFORM TAKE-SYNCPOINT
                  IF PA-FRAUD-REMOVED
                     MOVE 'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED...'   TO WS-MESSAGE
                  ELSE
                     MOVE 'AUTH MARKED FRAUD...'    TO WS-MESSAGE
                  END-IF
               WHEN OTHER
                  PERFORM ROLL-BACK
                  MOVE 'Y'     TO WS-ERR-FLG
                  STRING
                  ' System error while FRAUD Tagging, ROLLBACK||'
                  IMS-RETURN-CODE
                  DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  INTO WS-MESSAGE
                  END-STRING
                  PERFORM SEND-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN
           END-EVALUATE

error_handling.statement: PSB scheduling failure: If EXEC DLI SCHD returns a non-OK status (other than TC which is handled by term/reschedule), the error flag is set to 'Y' and an error message with the IMS return code is displayed.

code_references.snippet:
IF STATUS-OK
              SET IMS-PSB-SCHD           TO TRUE
           ELSE
              MOVE 'Y'     TO WS-ERR-FLG
              STRING
                  ' System error while scheduling PSB: Code:'
              IMS-RETURN-CODE
              DELIMITED BY SIZE
              INTO WS-MESSAGE
              END-STRING
              PERFORM SEND-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN
           END-IF

error_handling.statement: CICS LINK failure to COPAUS2C: If EIBRESP is not DFHRESP(NORMAL), a CICS SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK is performed to undo any IMS changes made in the current unit of work.

code_references.snippet:
IF EIBRESP = DFHRESP(NORMAL)
              IF WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS
                 PERFORM UPDATE-AUTH-DETAILS
              ELSE
                 MOVE WS-FRD-ACT-MSG     TO WS-MESSAGE
                 PERFORM ROLL-BACK
              END-IF
           ELSE
              PERFORM ROLL-BACK
           END-IF

error_handling.statement: ROLL-BACK procedure: Issues CICS SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK to undo all IMS database changes in the current unit of work when an error occurs during fraud processing or update.

code_references.snippet:
ROLL-BACK.
           EXEC CICS
              SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK
           END-EXEC

error_handling.statement: Invalid input guard in PROCESS-ENTER-KEY: If CDEMO-ACCT-ID is not numeric or CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED is spaces/low-values, the error flag is set ON without attempting any IMS read.

code_references.snippet:
IF CDEMO-ACCT-ID IS NUMERIC AND
              CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES
              ...
           ELSE
              SET ERR-FLG-ON                TO TRUE
           END-IF

error_handling.statement: Decline reason lookup error guard: If the binary search over WS-DECLINE-REASON-TAB finds no matching code, the response reason field is populated with '9999-ERROR' to flag an unrecognized code.

code_references.snippet:
SEARCH ALL WS-DECLINE-REASON-TAB
                   AT END
                        MOVE '9999'                     TO AUTHRSNO
                        MOVE '-'                        TO AUTHRSNO(5:1)
                        MOVE 'ERROR'                    TO AUTHRSNO(6:)

downstream_effects.statement: COPAUS0C (Authorization Summary screen): When the user presses PF3, control is transferred to this program via CICS XCTL, and the updated CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (including any changed navigation context) is passed to it.

code_references.snippet:
RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN.
           MOVE WS-CICS-TRANID TO CDEMO-FROM-TRANID
           MOVE WS-PGM-AUTH-DTL TO CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM
           MOVE ZEROS          TO CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT
           SET CDEMO-PGM-ENTER TO TRUE
           EXEC CICS
               XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM)
               COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)
           END-EXEC

downstream_effects.statement: COPAUS2C (Fraud Handler program): Receives the WS-FRAUD-DATA commarea containing the pending authorization record, account ID, customer ID, and fraud action flag (Report/Remove), and is expected to perform external fraud system updates and return WS-FRD-UPDATE-STATUS and WS-FRD-ACT-MSG.

code_references.snippet:
EXEC CICS LINK
                PROGRAM(WS-PGM-AUTH-FRAUD)
                COMMAREA(WS-FRAUD-DATA)
                NOHANDLE
           END-EXEC
           IF EIBRESP = DFHRESP(NORMAL)
              IF WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS
                 PERFORM UPDATE-AUTH-DETAILS
              ELSE
                 MOVE WS-FRD-ACT-MSG     TO WS-MESSAGE
                 PERFORM ROLL-BACK
              END-IF

downstream_effects.statement: IMS Pending Authorization Database (PAUTDTL1 segment): When PF5 fraud marking succeeds, the PAUTDTL1 segment for the selected authorization is updated in place via EXEC DLI REPL with the new fraud status (PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED or PA-FRAUD-REMOVED) and fraud report date, committed by CICS SYNCPOINT.

code_references.snippet:
UPDATE-AUTH-DETAILS.
           MOVE WS-FRAUD-AUTH-RECORD           TO PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS
           DISPLAY 'RPT DT: ' PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE
           EXEC DLI REPL USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
                SEGMENT (PAUTDTL1)
                FROM (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS)
           END-EXEC
           ...
           WHEN STATUS-OK
              PERFORM TAKE-SYNCPOINT
              IF PA-FRAUD-REMOVED
                 MOVE 'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED...'   TO WS-MESSAGE
              ELSE
                 MOVE 'AUTH MARKED FRAUD...'    TO WS-MESSAGE
              END-IF

downstream_effects.statement: CICS Transaction CPVD: Each EXEC CICS RETURN specifies TRANSID(CPVD), meaning the terminal session remains associated with this transaction ID for all subsequent user interactions with the authorization detail view.

code_references.snippet:
EXEC CICS RETURN
                     TRANSID (WS-CICS-TRANID)
                     COMMAREA (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA)
           END-EXEC
